sites.caption: Render prop manager stats
sites.consumer: RenderHUD @0x82628EB0 gates RenderStats @0x826131E8; three live prop-manager counters.

sites.caption: Render prop centre of mass
sites.consumer: PropManager::ReadUpdatedBodies @0x82632918 checks mbRenderCOM and draws the updated transform with DrawAxis.

sites.caption: Disable prop freezing
sites.consumer: PropManager::ReadUpdatedBodies @0x82632918 folds mbDisableFreezing into the outgoing frozen/removal event bit.

sites.caption: Override Prop LOD
sites.consumer: PropEntityModule::RenderModel @0x822C4918 checks mbOverrideLod before selecting the forced state.

sites.caption: Prop LOD number
sites.consumer: PropEntityModule::RenderModel @0x822C4918 casts miLodOverrideValue to model state and checks DoesStateExist.

sites.caption: OverridePropDistances
sites.consumer: PropEntityModule::RenderModel @0x822C4918 reads mbOverrideLodDistances for cull and per-LOD switch distances.
